payload.posture: Read Luke 11:1–4 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states luke’s prayer places holy name, coming Kingdom, bread, forgiveness, and testing together. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
